title: 使用高级句型至少3个。
description:
A Beacon of Medical Integrity: The Legacy of Lan Yuefeng

Dear friends,

I want to highlight Lan Yuefeng, a former ultrasound department director hailed as "China’s medical conscience." As a senior doctor, she bravely exposed over-treatment and false examinations at her hospital that exploited patients.

Despite demotion, suspension, and pressure, she refused to compromise medical ethics, prioritizing patients’ interests by declining unnecessary tests. Her courage sparked widespread social attention to healthcare irregularities, pushing industry standardization.

Lan’s unwavering commitment to integrity embodies the true medical spirit. As future medics, let’s inherit her courage—uphold professional ethics, defend patient rights, and safeguard the nobility of medicine.

Thank you.
